reference.source: KD Tripathi Essentials of Medical Pharmacology 8th Edition and Kaplan Pharmacology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: First line: thiazide like, ACE inhibitor or ARB, calcium blocker
ACE cough from bradykinin; angioedema is the emergency
Spironolactone is fourth drug for resistant hypertension
Pregnancy: methyldopa, labetalol, nifedipine; RAAS blockers fetotoxic
reference.pathophysiology: Essential hypertension sustains vascular resistance and volume through renin angiotensin activation, sympathetic tone, endothelial dysfunction and arterial stiffening, injuring brain, heart, kidney and retina in proportion to level and duration. Each drug class interrupts one limb (volume, renin, calcium entry, adrenergic drive), so combinations at low doses beat maximal single agents in efficacy and tolerability.
additionalDifferentials: Dihydropyridine versus rate limiting calcium blockers
additionalInvestigations: Home and ambulatory blood pressure confirmation
Electrolytes, creatinine and urine albumin surveillance
Aldosterone renin ratio and sleep studies in resistant cases
